+import pytest
+
+import click
+from click.core import UNSET
+
+
+def make_param(kind, **kwargs):
+    if kind == "option":
+        return click.Option(["--item"], type=int, **kwargs)
+    return click.Argument(["item"], type=int, required=False, **kwargs)
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("kind", ["option", "argument"])
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("inherited", [False, True])
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("callable_default", [False, True])
+def test_factory_can_decline(kind, inherited, callable_default):
+    calls = {"map": 0, "default": 0}
+
+    def factory():
+        calls["map"] += 1
+        return UNSET if calls["map"] == 1 else 99
+
+    def declared():
+        calls["default"] += 1
+        return 17
+
+    param = make_param(kind, default=declared if callable_default else 17)
+    cmd = click.Command("leaf", params=[param], add_help_option=False)
+    mapping = {"item": factory}
+    parent = click.Context(click.Group("root"), default_map={"leaf": mapping})
+    extra = {"parent": parent} if inherited else {"default_map": mapping}
+
+    with cmd.make_context("leaf", [], **extra) as ctx:
+        assert ctx.params["item"] == 17
+        assert ctx.get_parameter_source("item") is click.ParameterSource.DEFAULT
+    assert calls == {"map": 1, "default": int(callable_default)}
+    assert mapping["item"] is factory
+
+    with cmd.make_context("leaf", [], **extra) as ctx:
+        assert ctx.params["item"] == 99
+        assert ctx.get_parameter_source("item") is click.ParameterSource.DEFAULT_MAP
+    assert calls == {"map": 2, "default": int(callable_default)}
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("kind", ["option", "argument"])
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("value", [UNSET, None, 23])
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("as_factory", [False, True])
+def test_map_results(kind, value, as_factory):
+    calls = []
+
+    def factory():
+        calls.append(True)
+        return value
+
+    param = make_param(kind, default=17)
+    cmd = click.Command("leaf", params=[param], add_help_option=False)
+    entry = factory if as_factory else value
+    with cmd.make_context("leaf", [], default_map={"item": entry}) as ctx:
+        assert ctx.params["item"] == (17 if value is UNSET else value)
+        source = (
+            click.ParameterSource.DEFAULT
+            if value is UNSET
+            else click.ParameterSource.DEFAULT_MAP
+        )
+        assert ctx.get_parameter_source("item") is source
+    assert len(calls) == int(as_factory)
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("kind", ["option", "argument"])
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("use_cli", [False, True])
+def test_higher_precedence_skips_factory(kind, use_cli, monkeypatch):

spec.question:
A default_map factory needs a way to decline supplying a value. Support returning Click's internal UNSET sentinel for that purpose: during parameter acquisition, evaluate the map factory once, then use the parameter's declared default with DEFAULT provenance if the result is UNSET. This must work for ordinary options and arguments, including default maps inherited by subcommand contexts. The decision is local to that acquisition; leave the map entry intact so a later acquisition can evaluate it again and accept a real value.

Keep stored UNSET entries equivalent to missing entries, and preserve explicit None results as DEFAULT_MAP values. Callable declared defaults must still be evaluated when needed, while command-line or environment input must prevent evaluation of the map factory. Retain Option's lazy flag-default behavior, including not invoking a callable flag activation value merely because it becomes the default. Return a unified diff against the repository files, without changing tests.

suggestion.description: Repair a different callable default-map defect in src/click/core.py: when a map-entry factory returns the internal UNSET sentinel, Parameter.consume_value falls through to self.get_default(ctx), which reads and calls the same factory again instead of using the declared default. Treat a factory's UNSET result as an absent map value for that acquisition, fall back to the declared default with DEFAULT provenance, and evaluate the map factory only once. Apply this to ordinary options and arguments, including inherited maps. Preserve callable declared defaults, explicit None map results, command-line/environment precedence, and Option's lazy flag-default rules. Return a unified diff without changing tests.
suggestion.expected_answer_change: The repair depends on the interaction between Context.lookup_default, Context._default_map_has, Parameter.consume_value, Parameter.get_default, and Option._resolve_lazy_default. It must provide a declared-default fallback that does not re-read the map while preserving Option-specific default derivation. Verification should include a factory that returns UNSET first and a real value second, a callable declared fallback, explicit None, and higher-precedence input that prevents factory evaluation entirely.
suggestion.why_substantive: The defect is repeated acquisition of a missing-value result, not failure to split a present string. A stateful factory can currently supply a different value on its second call, causing both the value and provenance to be wrong. The accepted string-normalization patch does not address this failure.
